# Templates

Every page in this hub follows one of these templates, so knowledge stays consistent and easy to compare.

| Template | Use it for |
| --- | --- |
| [Module design doc](module-design-doc.md) | A new topic module in `docs/modules/` (`scripts/new_module.py` uses this template) |
| [Prompt card](prompt-card.md) | A reusable prompt worth keeping. The canonical copy also goes in `prompts/` as YAML |
| [Course notes](course-notes.md) | Notes for one tutorial or course in `docs/tutorials/notes/` |
| [Journal entry](../journal/entry-template.md) | A dated experiment or learning log entry |
